\pl{0.00}{DAILY PRAYERS.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{HOURS OF PRAYER.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{ALWAYS.}
\pl{1.20}{Without ceasing.}
\pl{1.20}{At every season.}
\pl{0.00}{Three seasons of the day he was bowing upon his knees,}
\pl{1.20}{and praying, and giving thanks before his God,}
\pl{1.20}{as he did aforetime.}
\pl{0.00}{Evening and morning and at noonday will I declare it,}
\pl{1.20}{and make it known, and he shall hear my voice.}
\pl{0.00}{Seven times a day have I praised thee.}
\pl{1.20}{1. Early in the morning, a great while before day.}
\pl{1.20}{2. At the dawning.}
\pl{1.20}{3. At the third hour of the day.}
\pl{1.20}{4. About the sixth hour.}
\pl{1.20}{5. At the ninth hour, the hour of prayer.}
\pl{1.20}{6. Toward the eventide.}
\pl{1.20}{7. In the night watches.}
\pl{2.40}{At midnight.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{PLACES OF PRAYER.}
\pl{0.00}{In every place where I record my name, thither will I come unto thee, and}
\pl{1.20}{I will bless thee.}
\pl{2.40}{The congregation.}
\pl{0.00}{In the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.}
}

\pl{1.20}{together with us in this hour.}
\pl{0.00}{Remember their readiness and their diligence.}

\pl{1.20}{have mercy upon them and upon us according to the multitude of thy mercy,}
\pl{1.20}{O Lord.}

\pl{0.00}{CONFESSIONS.}
\pl{0.00}{Woe is me, I have sinned against thee, O Lord, I have sinned against thee.}
\pl{1.20}{O what things I was committing,}
\pl{1.20}{and thou hast not requited me as my sins deserved.}
\pl{2.40}{But I am ashamed,}
\pl{0.00}{and I turn away from my evil ways,}
\pl{0.00}{and I turn again unto mine own heart,}
\pl{0.00}{and with my whole heart I turn again unto thee.}
\pl{2.40}{And I seek thy face,}
\pl{3.60}{and I beseech thee, saying,}
\pl{1.20}{I have sinned, I have done iniquity, I have done wickedly;}
\pl{1.20}{I know, O Lord, the plague of mine own heart,}
\pl{1.20}{and behold, I turn again unto thee}
\pl{2.40}{with all my heart, and}
\pl{2.40}{with all my strength.}
\pl{0.00}{And now thou, O Lord, from thy dwelling place,}
\pl{1.20}{from the throne of the glory of thy kingdom in the heavens,}
\pl{2.40}{hear thou the prayer}
\pl{3.60}{and the supplication of thy servant,}
\pl{4.80}{and be merciful unto thy servant,}
\pl{6.00}{and heal his soul.}
\pl{0.00}{I dare not so much as lift up mine eyes}
\pl{1.20}{unto heaven,}

\pl{1.20}{Τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν\hspace{3.60em}Παράσχου, Κύριε.}

\pl{0.00}{ΟΥΣΙΑ ὑπερούσιε, φύσις ἄκτιστε,}
\pl{1.20}{Τοῦ ὅλου δημιουργὲ,}
\pl{0.00}{Προορῶ σε, Κύριε, ἐνώπιόν μου,}
\pl{0.00}{Καὶ ἀείρω πρός σε τὴν ψυχήν μου.}
\pl{0.00}{Προσκυνῶ σε θεὶς τὰ γόνατα,}
\pl{1.20}{Καὶ ταπεινοῦμαι ὑπὸ τὴν κραταιάν σου χεῖρα.}
\pl{1.20}{Διαπεταννύω πρός σε τὰς χεῖράς μου,}
\pl{0.00}{Ἡ ψυχή μου γῆ ἄνυδρός σοι.}
\pl{2.40}{Τύπτω εἰς τὸ στῆθός μου,}
\pl{2.40}{Καὶ λέγω μετὰ Τελωνοῦ,}
\pl{0.00}{Ὁ Θεὸς ἱλάσθητί μοι \{ τῷ ἁμαρτωλῷ, / τῷ πάνυ. \}}
\pl{2.40}{Τῷ ἁμαρτωλῷ ὑπὲρ Τελωνοῦ}
\pl{2.40}{Ἱλάσθητι ὥσπερ τῷ Τελωνῇ.}
\pl{2.40}{Πάτερ οἰκτιρμῶν,}
\pl{1.20}{Δέομαι τῆς πατρικῆς σου εὐσπλαγχνίας,}
\pl{1.20}{Μή με παρίδῃς \{ Σκώληκα ῥυπαρόν. / Κύνα τεθνηκότα. / Θνησιμαῖον σαπρόν. \}}

\pglabel{printed 18}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise,}
\pl{1.20}{to think on these things, and to do these things —}
\pl{3.60}{Grant, O Lord.}
\pl{0.00}{A Christian ending to our life,}
\pl{1.20}{without sin, without shame,}
\pl{1.20}{and, if it seem good to thee, without pain,}
\pl{0.00}{And a good defence before the dread}
\pl{1.20}{and fearful judgement-seat of Jesus Christ}
\pl{1.20}{our Lord —}
\pl{3.60}{Grant, O Lord.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O BEING beyond all being, nature uncreated,}
\pl{1.20}{Maker of the whole,}
\pl{0.00}{I have set thee, O Lord, before me,}
\pl{0.00}{And I lift up my soul unto thee.}
\pl{0.00}{I worship thee, bowing my knees,}
\pl{1.20}{and I humble myself under thy mighty hand.}
\pl{1.20}{I spread forth my hands unto thee,}
\pl{0.00}{My soul is unto thee as a thirsty land.}
\pl{2.40}{I smite upon my breast,}
\pl{2.40}{and say with the Publican,}
\pl{0.00}{God be merciful to me \{ a sinner, / a sinner utterly. \}}
\pl{2.40}{To me a sinner above the Publican}
\pl{2.40}{be merciful, even as to the Publican.}
\pl{2.40}{O Father of mercies,}
\pl{1.20}{I beseech thy fatherly compassion,}
\pl{1.20}{despise me not — \{ a foul worm, / a dead dog, / a rotten carcase. \}}
}

\pl{0.00}{quæcunque casta, quæcunque amabilia, quæcunque bonæ}

}

\pl{0.00}{Δὸς ἐμοὶ λαλεῖν εἰρήνην περὶ αὐτῶν,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ ἐκζητεῖν ἀγαθὰ αὐτοῖς.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ὁ βουλόμενος ἀνταμεῖψαι}
\pl{2.40}{ἡμᾶς τοῖς ἀγαθοποιοῦσι,}
\pl{0.00}{Μνήσθητι, Κύριε, εἰς ἀγαθὸν πάντων}
\pl{1.20}{ὑφ’ ὧν εὐπέπονθα·}

\pglabel{printed 58}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{1.20}{to be subject unto authority,}
\pl{1.20}{not only for wrath,}
\pl{2.40}{but also for conscience' sake.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{TO THE husbandmen and the herdsmen, a good year,}
\pl{1.20}{to the fleet and the fishers, fair seas;}
\pl{1.20}{to them that trade, not to overreach one another,}
\pl{1.20}{to the craftsmen, lawfully to work}
\pl{2.40}{at their own crafts;}
\pl{1.20}{yea, and even down unto the mean trades,}
\pl{1.20}{yea, and even down unto the poor.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O GOD, not of us alone,}
\pl{1.20}{but of our seed also;}
\pl{0.00}{Bless our children among us,}
\pl{1.20}{that they may go forward in wisdom,}
\pl{2.40}{as in stature, and in favour}
\pl{3.60}{with thee and with men.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O thou who wouldest have us care for our own,}
\pl{2.40}{and hatest them that are without natural affection,}
\pl{1.20}{Remember, O Lord, them that are my}
\pl{2.40}{kinsfolk after the flesh.}
\pl{0.00}{Grant me to speak peace concerning them,}
\pl{1.20}{and to seek out good things for them.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O thou who art minded to repay}
\pl{2.40}{us that do good to others,}
\pl{0.00}{Remember, O Lord, unto good all those}
\pl{1.20}{at whose hands I have received good;}
}

\pl{0.00}{Memor esto, Domine, meorum secundum carnem pro-}

\pl{1.20}{et illorum bona quærere.}

\pl{0.00}{Memor esto in bonum, Domine, omnium}

\pl{2.40}{εἰς θέλημα ἐχθρῶν.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ὁ τῶν οἰκείων ἀμελοῦντα}

\pl{0.00}{Μνήσθητι ἐν εὐδοκίᾳ σου πάντων}

\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ὁ θέλων περισσεύειν δικαιοσύνην ἡμῶν}

\pl{1.20}{Ἀνταγαπᾶν τοὺς ἀγαπῶντας ἐμὲ}

\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ὁ θέλων ἡμᾶς νικᾶν ἐν τῷ ἀγαθῷ τὸ κακὸν,}

\pl{3.60}{σου βασιλείαν, ὡς καὶ ἐμέ.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ὁ χαρισάμενος ταῖς προσευχαῖς τῶν δούλων σου}
\pl{1.20}{ὑπὲρ ἀλλήλων,}
\pl{0.00}{Μνήσθητι, Κύριε, εἰς ἀγαθὸν,}
\pl{0.00}{καὶ δῴης ἔλεος πᾶσι τοῖς ἐμὲ διὰ μνήμης ἔχουσιν,}
\pl{2.40}{ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς αὐτῶν·}

\pglabel{printed 60}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{Give them life, and count them blessed in the earth,}

\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O thou who him that is careless of his own}
\pl{1.20}{hast written down worse than an unbeliever,}
\pl{0.00}{Remember in thy good pleasure all them}
\pl{1.20}{that are within my stewardship.}

\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O thou who wouldest have our righteousness abound}

\pl{2.40}{My friends, and my father's friends,}
\pl{1.20}{and my friends' children, never to forsake.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O thou who wouldest have us overcome evil with good,}

\pl{1.20}{Have mercy upon mine enemies, O Lord,}

\pl{2.40}{and bring them unto thy heavenly}
\pl{3.60}{kingdom, even as me also.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O thou who hast granted the prayers of thy servants}

\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Vouchsafe also, O Lord, to remember}
\pl{1.20}{our Fathers in holiness,}
\pl{0.00}{the honourable Presbytery, and all the clergy,}
\pl{1.20}{rightly dividing the word of truth,}
\pl{1.20}{and walking uprightly therein.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Remember, O Lord, the brethren that stand round about us,}
\pl{1.20}{and pray together with us in this holy hour,}
\pl{1.20}{their earnestness and their zeal.}
}

\pglabel{printed 121}{Latin}

\pl{1.20}{Memento piorum et fidelium Regum,}
\pl{0.00}{quos dignos habuisti qui regnarent super terram.}
\pl{1.20}{Et in primis memento, Domine,}
\pl{1.20}{divinitus custoditi Regis nostri:}
\pl{2.40}{corrobora imperium ejus,}
\pl{1.20}{Subde sub illo omnes adversarios:}
\pl{2.40}{loquere ipsius cordi bona}
\pl{0.00}{Pro Ecclesia et omni populo tuo.}
\pl{1.20}{Concede illi profundam et illibatam pacem,}
\pl{2.40}{ut in ipsius tranquillitate}
\pl{1.20}{Tranquillam et quietam vitam degamus}
\pl{2.40}{cum omni pietate et castimonia. [1 \emph{Tim.} ii. 2.]}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Memento, Domine, omnis Principatus et}
\pl{3.60}{potestatis,}
\pl{2.40}{et Fratrum in Palatio,}
\pl{0.00}{Quique in concilio et foro eminent,}
\pl{1.20}{omniumque, qua terra, qua mari,}
\pl{2.40}{pro nobis tua bella gerentium.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Etiam meminisse, Domine, digneris}
\pl{1.20}{Sanctorum Patrum nostrorum,}
\pl{0.00}{Venerabilis Presbyterii, et universi Cleri,}
\pl{1.20}{Recte secantis verbum veritatis, [2 \emph{Tim.} ii. 15.]}
\pl{2.40}{et recto pede incedentis in eodem. [\emph{Gal.} ii. 14.]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Memento, Domine, fratrum nos circumstantium,}
\pl{1.20}{Et comprecantium nobiscum in ista hora sancta,}
\pl{2.40}{ob studium et alacritatem ipsorum.}

\pglabel{printed 122}{Greek}

\pl{0.00}{Μνήσθητι καὶ τῶν δι' εὐλόγους αἰτίας ἀπολειφθέντων,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ ἐλέησον αὐτοὺς καὶ ἡμᾶς}
\pl{2.40}{κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ ἐλέους σου.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Τὰ ταμεῖα ἡμῶν ἔμπλησον παντὸς ἀγαθοῦ,}
\pl{1.20}{τὰς συζυγίας ἡμῶν ἐν εἰρήνῃ καὶ ὁμονοίᾳ διατήρησον}
\pl{2.40}{τὰ νήπια ἔκθρεψον,}
\pl{2.40}{τὴν νεότητα παιδαγώγησον,}
\pl{2.40}{τὸ γῆρας περικράτησον,}
\pl{2.40}{τοὺς ὀλιγοψύχους παραμύθησαι,}
\pl{2.40}{τοὺς ἐσκορπισμένους ἐπισυνάγαγε,}
\pl{2.40}{τοὺς πεπλανημένους ἐπανάγαγε, καὶ}
\pl{0.00}{σύναψον τῇ ἁγίᾳ καὶ καθολικῇ καὶ ἀποστολικῇ}
\pl{2.40}{σου Ἐκκλησίᾳ·}
\pl{2.40}{τοὺς ὀχλουμένους ὑπὸ τῶν πνευμάτων}
\pl{3.60}{ἀκαθάρτων ἐλευθέρωσον}
\pl{2.40}{τοῖς πλέουσι σύμπλευσον,}
\pl{2.40}{τοῖς ὁδοιποροῦσι συνόδευσον,}
\pl{3.60}{χηρῶν πρόστηθι,}
\pl{3.60}{ὀρφανῶν ὑπεράσπισον,}
\pl{3.60}{αἰχμαλώτους ῥῦσαι,}
\pl{3.60}{νοσοῦντας ἴασαι·}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Τῶν ἐν βήμασι, καὶ μετάλλοις, καὶ ἐξορίαις,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ τριήρεσι, καὶ πάσῃ θλίψει, καὶ ἀνάγκῃ,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ περιστάσει ὄντων, μνημόνευσον ὁ Θεὸς,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ πάντων δεομένων}
\pl{2.40}{τῆς μεγάλης σου εὐσπλαγχνίας·}
\pl{0.00}{Καὶ τῶν ἀγαπώντων ἡμᾶς,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ τῶν μισούντων,}

\pglabel{printed 122}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{Remember also them that for good cause are absent,}
\pl{1.20}{and have mercy upon them and upon us}
\pl{2.40}{according to the multitude of thy mercy.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Fill our storehouses with all good things,}
\pl{1.20}{keep our marriages in peace and concord,}
\pl{2.40}{nourish the little children,}
\pl{2.40}{train up the youth,}
\pl{2.40}{uphold the aged,}
\pl{2.40}{comfort the fainthearted,}
\pl{2.40}{gather together them that are scattered,}
\pl{2.40}{bring back them that are gone astray, and}
\pl{0.00}{join them unto thy holy and catholic and apostolic}
\pl{2.40}{Church;}
\pl{2.40}{them that are vexed by the unclean}
\pl{3.60}{spirits, set free,}
\pl{2.40}{with them that sail, sail thou,}
\pl{2.40}{with them that journey, journey thou,}
\pl{3.60}{stand up for the widows,}
\pl{3.60}{shield the fatherless,}
\pl{3.60}{deliver the captives,}
\pl{3.60}{heal the sick;}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Them that are at the tribunals, and in the mines, and in banishments,}
\pl{1.20}{and in the galleys, and in all tribulation, and necessity,}
\pl{1.20}{and distress, remember, O God,}
\pl{1.20}{and all that stand in need}
\pl{2.40}{of thy great compassion;}
\pl{0.00}{Both them that love us,}
\pl{1.20}{and them that hate us,}
}

\pglabel{printed 123}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{Memento et eorum, qui justis de causis absunt,}
\pl{1.20}{et miserere illis sicut et nobis,}
\pl{2.40}{secundum multitudinem misericordiæ tuæ.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Promptuaria nostra reple omni bono, [\emph{Psal.} cxliv. 13.]}
\pl{0.00}{Conjugia nostra in pace et concordia conserva,}
\pl{2.40}{Enutri infantes,}
\pl{1.20}{Juventutem erudi,}
\pl{1.20}{Senectutem sustenta,}
\pl{1.20}{Pusillanimes consolare, [1 \emph{Thess.} v. 14.]}
\pl{1.20}{Dispersos congrega,}
\pl{1.20}{Errantes reduc, et}
\pl{0.00}{Sanctæ tuæ, et Catholicæ, et Apostolicæ}
\pl{2.40}{Ecclesiæ annecte:}
\pl{1.20}{Vexatos a spiritibus}
\pl{2.40}{Immundis libera;}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Navigantibus, navigationis}
\pl{0.00}{Viatoribus, itineris \} comes accede,}
\pl{2.40}{Viduis patrocinare,}
\pl{2.40}{Pupillos protege,}
\pl{2.40}{Captivos libera,}
\pl{2.40}{Ægrotantibus medere.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Qui ad tribunalia, et in metallis, et exsiliis}
\pl{1.20}{et triremibus, et omni angustia, et necessitate,}
\pl{2.40}{et adversitate sunt, eorum memento, Deus,}
\pl{3.60}{et omnium qui indigent}
\pl{4.80}{magna tua misericordia;}
\pl{0.00}{Et diligentium nos,}
\pl{1.20}{et odio habentium,}

\pglabel{printed 124}{Greek}

\pl{1.20}{καὶ τῶν ἐντειλαμένων ἡμῖν τοῖς ἀναξίοις,}
\pl{2.40}{ὥστε μνημονεύειν αὐτῶν ἐν ταῖς}
\pl{2.40}{προσευχαῖς ἡμῶν.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Καὶ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ σου μνήσθητι, Κύριε, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ ἐπὶ πάντας ἔκχεον τὸ πλούσιόν σου ἔλεος,}
\pl{1.20}{πᾶσι παρέχων τὰ πρὸς σωτηρίαν αἰτήματα.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Καὶ ὧν ἡμεῖς οὐκ ἐμνημονεύσαμεν,}
\pl{0.00}{δι' ἄγνοιαν, ἢ λήθην, ἢ πλῆθος ὀνομάτων,}
\pl{1.20}{αὐτὸς μνημόνευσον ὁ Θεὸς, ὁ εἰδὼς}
\pl{0.00}{ἑκάστου τὴν ἡλικίαν, καὶ τὴν προσηγορίαν,}
\pl{1.20}{ὁ εἰδὼς ἕκαστον ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς αὐτοῦ.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Σὺ γὰρ εἶ, Κύριε, ἡ βοήθεια τῶν ἀβοηθήτων,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ ἡ ἐλπὶς τῶν ἀπελπισμένων,}
\pl{2.40}{ὁ τῶν χειμαζομένων σωτὴρ,}
\pl{2.40}{ὁ τῶν πλεόντων λιμὴν,}
\pl{2.40}{ὁ τῶν νοσούντων ἰατρὸς,}
\pl{1.20}{αὐτὸς τοῖς πᾶσι τὰ πάντα γενοῦ.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Ὁ εἰδὼς ἕκαστον καὶ τὸ αἴτημα αὐτοῦ,}
\pl{1.20}{οἶκον καὶ τὴν χρείαν αὐτοῦ,}
\pl{0.00}{Ῥῦσαι, Κύριε, τὴν πόλιν ταύτην, καὶ}
\pl{1.20}{πᾶσαν τὴν χώραν ἐν ᾗ παροικοῦμεν,}
\pl{1.20}{ἀπὸ λοιμοῦ, λιμοῦ, σεισμοῦ, καταποντισμοῖ,}
\pl{1.20}{πυρὸς, μαχαίρας, ἐπιδρομῆς ἀλλοφύλων,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ ἐμφυλίου στασιασμοῦ.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Παῦσον τὰ σχίσματα τῶν Ἐκκλησιῶν,}
\pl{1.20}{σβέσον τὰ φρυάγματα τῶν ἐθνῶν,}
\pl{0.00}{Καὶ πάντας ἡμᾶς πρόσδεξαι εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν σου,}

\pglabel{printed 124}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{1.20}{and them that have charged us, unworthy as we are,}
\pl{2.40}{to make mention of them in our}
\pl{2.40}{prayers.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{And remember all thy people, O Lord our God,}
\pl{1.20}{and pour out upon all thy rich mercy,}
\pl{1.20}{affording unto all the petitions that are unto salvation.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{And those whom we have not remembered,}
\pl{0.00}{through ignorance, or forgetfulness, or the multitude of names,}
\pl{1.20}{do thou thyself remember, O God, who knowest}
\pl{0.00}{the age and the name of every one,}
\pl{1.20}{who knowest each one from his mother's womb.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{For thou, O Lord, art the help of the helpless,}
\pl{1.20}{and the hope of the hopeless,}
\pl{2.40}{the saviour of the tempest-tossed,}
\pl{2.40}{the haven of them that sail,}
\pl{2.40}{the physician of the sick;}
\pl{1.20}{be thou thyself all things unto all.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Thou that knowest each man and his petition,}
\pl{1.20}{his house and his need,}
\pl{0.00}{Deliver, O Lord, this city, and}
\pl{1.20}{all the country wherein we sojourn,}
\pl{1.20}{from plague, famine, earthquake, flood,}
\pl{1.20}{fire, sword, the invasion of aliens,}
\pl{2.40}{and civil strife.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Make the schisms of the Churches to cease,}
\pl{1.20}{quench the ragings of the nations,}
\pl{0.00}{And receive us all into thy kingdom,}
}

\pglabel{printed 125}{Latin}

\pl{1.20}{et mandantium nobis indignis,}
\pl{2.40}{ut memoriam illorum in orationibus}
\pl{2.40}{nostris haberemus.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Et omnis populi tui memento, Domine, Deus noster,}
\pl{1.20}{et super omnes effunde divitem tuam misericordiam,}
\pl{2.40}{omnibus præbens ad salutem requisita.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Et quorum nos non meminimus,}
\pl{0.00}{per ignorantiam, aut oblivionem, aut nominum multitudinem,}
\pl{1.20}{Ipse memento Deus, qui nosti}
\pl{0.00}{Uniuscujusque ætatem et appellationem,}
\pl{1.20}{qui nosti unumquemque ex utero matris ejus.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Tu enim es, Domine, opitulator inopum,}
\pl{2.40}{et spes desperantium,}
\pl{2.40}{Fluctuantium servator,}
\pl{2.40}{Navigantium portus,}
\pl{2.40}{Ægrotantium medicus,}
\pl{1.20}{Ipse omnibus omnia fias.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Qui nosti \{ hominem et desiderium ejus, / domum et necessitatem ejus, \}}
\pl{0.00}{Libera, Domine, istam civitatem, et}
\pl{1.20}{omnem regionem in qua inhabitamus,}
\pl{2.40}{a peste, fame, terræ motu, diluvio,}
\pl{2.40}{igne, gladio, invasione hostili,}
\pl{3.60}{et civili bello.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Compesce schismata Ecclesiarum,}
\pl{1.20}{Exstingue fremitus Gentium,}
\pl{0.00}{Et nos omnes recipe in Regnum tuum,}

\pglabel{printed 126}{Greek}

\pl{0.00}{Υἱοὺς φωτὸς ἀναδείξας·}

\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Μνήσθητι, Κύριε, ὁ Θεὸς,}
\pl{0.00}{πάντων πνευμάτων, καὶ πάσης σαρκὸς,}
\pl{1.20}{ὧν ἐμνήσθημεν, καὶ ὧν οὐκ ἐμνήσθημεν.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ἡμῶν δὲ τὰ τέλη τῆς ζωῆς}
\pl{0.00}{Χριστιανὰ, εὐάρεστα (κἄν σοι δοκῇ)}
\pl{2.40}{ἀνώδυνα,}
\pl{1.20}{ἐν εἰρήνῃ κατεύθυνον, Κύριε, Κύριε,}
\pl{0.00}{Ἐπισυνάγων ἡμᾶς ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν σου,}
\pl{2.40}{ὅτε θέλεις, καὶ ὡς θέλεις,}
\pl{2.40}{μόνον χωρὶς αἰσχύνης,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ ἁμαρτημάτων.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ἔστω ἡ λαμπρότης τοῦ Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν}
\pl{2.40}{ἐφ' ἡμᾶς,}
\pl{1.20}{Καὶ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν ἡμῶν κατεύθυνον}
\pl{2.40}{ἐφ' ἡμᾶς,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ τὸ ἔργον τῶν χειρῶν ἡμῶν κατεύθυνον.}
\parasep
\pl{2.40}{Ἴσθι Κύριε}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ἐντός | ἐνισχῦσαί}
\pl{0.00}{ἐκτός | φυλάξαι}
\pl{0.00}{ὑπέρ | σκεπάσαι}
\pl{0.00}{ὑπό | ἀντερεῖσαί}
\pl{0.00}{πρόσω | κατευθῦναί}
\pl{0.00}{ὀπίσω | ἀναγαγεῖν,}
\pl{0.00}{κύκλῳ περί | ὀχυρῶσαί,}

\pglabel{printed 126}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{having declared us sons of light;}
\pl{0.00}{And thine own peace and love}
\pl{1.20}{grant unto us, O Lord our God.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Remember, O Lord God,}
\pl{0.00}{of all spirits, and of all flesh,}
\pl{1.20}{whom we have remembered, and whom we have not remembered.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{And the ends of our life}
\pl{0.00}{Christian, well-pleasing (if so it seem good to thee)}
\pl{2.40}{and without pain,}
\pl{1.20}{order thou in peace, O Lord, O Lord,}
\pl{0.00}{gathering us together beneath the feet of thine elect,}
\pl{2.40}{when thou wilt, and as thou wilt,}
\pl{2.40}{only without shame,}
\pl{2.40}{and without sins.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Let the beauty of the Lord our God be}
\pl{2.40}{upon us,}
\pl{1.20}{And the works of our hands establish thou}
\pl{2.40}{upon us,}
\pl{1.20}{yea, the work of our hands establish thou.}

\pl{2.40}{Be thou, O Lord,}

\pl{0.00}{within | strengthen}

\pl{0.00}{before | direct}
\pl{0.00}{behind | bring back,}
\pl{0.00}{round about | fortify,}
}

\pl{0.00}{Filios lucis comprobans,}
\pl{0.00}{Tuamque Pacem et Charitatem}

\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Memento, Domine Deus,}
\pl{0.00}{omnium spirituum, et omnis carnis}
\pl{1.20}{quorum mentionem habuimus, et quorum non habuimus.}

\pl{1.20}{Nobis autem exitus Vitæ}
\pl{0.00}{Christianos, tibi acceptos et (si videbitur)}

\pl{1.20}{in pace dirige, Domine, Domine,}
\pl{0.00}{Colligens nos sub pedes electorum tuorum,}

\pl{2.40}{et peccatis.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Sit splendor Domini nostri}
\pl{2.40}{super nos,}

\pl{2.40}{super nos,}

\pl{2.40}{Esto, Domine,}

\pl{0.00}{Circumcirca | undique communias.}

\pglabel{printed 128}{Greek}

\pl{0.00}{ΕΥΛΟΓΗΤΟΣ εἶ, Κύριε, ὁ Θεὸς Ἰσραὴλ,}
\pl{1.20}{ὁ Πατὴρ ἡμῶν,}
\pl{0.00}{ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος.}
\pl{2.40}{Σοὶ, Κύριε,}
\pl{1.20}{ἡ μεγαλωσύνη,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ ἡ δύναμις,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ τὸ καύχημα,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ ἡ νίκη,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ ἡ ἐξομολόγησις,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ ἡ ἰσχὺς,}
\pl{0.00}{ὅτι σὺ πάντων ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς δεσπόζεις.}
\pl{0.00}{Ἀπὸ προσώπου σου ταράσσεται πᾶς βασιλεὺς,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ πᾶν ἔθνος.}
\pl{1.20}{Σοὶ, Κύριε, ἡ βασιλεία,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ ἡ ἔπαρσις εἰς πάντα,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ εἰς πᾶσαν ἀρχήν.}
\pl{0.00}{Παρὰ σοῦ ὁ πλοῦτος, καὶ ἡ δόξα ἐκ προσώπου σου.}
\pl{1.20}{Σὺ πάντων ἄρχεις, Κύριε,}
\pl{2.40}{ὁ ἄρχων πάσης ἀρχῆς,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ ἐν χειρί σου ἰσχὺς, καὶ δυναστεία,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ ἐν χειρί σου μεγαλῦναι,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ κατισχῦσαι τὰ πάντα.}
\pl{0.00}{Καὶ νῦν, Κύριε, ἐξομολογούμεθά σοι}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ αἰνοῦμεν τὸ ὄνομα τῆς καυχήσεώς σου.}

\pglabel{printed 128}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{BLESSED art thou, O Lord, the God of Israel,}
\pl{1.20}{our Father,}
\pl{0.00}{from everlasting to everlasting.}
\pl{2.40}{Thine, O Lord,}
\pl{1.20}{is the greatness,}
\pl{2.40}{and the power,}
\pl{2.40}{and the glory,}
\pl{2.40}{and the victory,}
\pl{2.40}{and the praise,}
\pl{2.40}{and the might,}
\pl{0.00}{for thou art over all in heaven,}
\pl{1.20}{and rulest upon the earth.}
\pl{0.00}{At thy presence every king is troubled,}
\pl{1.20}{and every nation.}
\pl{1.20}{Thine, O Lord, is the kingdom,}
\pl{1.20}{and the exaltation above all,}
\pl{2.40}{and above all rule.}
\pl{0.00}{Of thee cometh riches, and glory cometh from thy presence.}
\pl{1.20}{Thou reignest over all, O Lord,}
\pl{2.40}{the ruler of all rule,}
\pl{1.20}{and in thine hand is power and might,}
\pl{2.40}{and in thine hand it is to make great,}
\pl{2.40}{and to give strength unto all.}
\pl{0.00}{And now, O Lord, we give thee thanks,}
\pl{1.20}{and praise thy glorious name.}
}

\pglabel{printed 129}{Latin}

\pl{1.20}{BENEDICTUS es, Domine, Deus Israel,}
\pl{2.40}{Pater noster,}
\pl{1.20}{ab æterno in æternum, 1 \emph{Chron.} xxix. 10.}
\pl{2.40}{Tua est, Domine,}
\pl{1.20}{Magnificentia,}
\pl{2.40}{et Potentia,}
\pl{2.40}{et Gloria,}
\pl{2.40}{atque Victoria,}
\pl{2.40}{[et laus,}
\pl{2.40}{et potestas,]}
\pl{0.00}{Cuncta enim quæ in cœlo sunt,}
\pl{1.20}{et in terra tua sunt. [\emph{Vers.} 11.]}
\pl{0.00}{A vultu tuo conturbatur omnis Rex,}
\pl{1.20}{Et gens omnis. [\emph{Is.} lxiv. 2.]}
\pl{1.20}{Tuum, Domine, Regnum,}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{HOSANNA IN THE HIGHEST.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{REMEMBER me, O Lord,}
\pl{1.20}{with the favour of thy people,}
\pl{0.00}{O visit me with thy salvation,}
\pl{1.20}{that I may see the good of thy chosen,}
\pl{1.20}{that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation,}
\pl{2.40}{that I may give thanks unto thee with thine inheritance.}
\pl{0.00}{For there is a glory that shall be revealed.}
\pl{2.40}{For when the Judge cometh,}
\pl{1.20}{some shall see his face gladsome,}
\pl{0.00}{they shall be set on the right hand,}
\pl{1.20}{they shall hear the sweetest voice,}
\pl{2.40}{Come, ye blessed.}
\pl{0.00}{They shall be caught up in the clouds to}
\pl{1.20}{meet the Lord,}
\pl{0.00}{they shall enter into the joy,}
\pl{1.20}{they shall have the fruition of the sight of him,}
\pl{2.40}{they shall ever be with him.}
\pl{0.00}{They alone, they only, are blessed}
\pl{1.20}{among the sons of men.}
\pl{0.00}{O grant me, the last, a last place there,}
\pl{1.20}{beneath their feet;}
\pl{0.00}{beneath the feet of thy chosen,}
\pl{1.20}{the least among them.}
\pl{2.40}{And that this may be,}
}

\sectionhead{The Evening Office}

\pglabel{printed 220}{Greek}

\pl{0.00}{[Ἡ ΔΕΙΛΙΝΗ ΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΙΑ.]}

\pl{0.00}{ΤΗΝ ἡμέραν διαβὰς}
\pl{1.20}{εὐχαριστῶ σοι, Κύριε.}
\pl{2.40}{Ἐγγίζει ἡ ἑσπέρα,}
\pl{1.20}{φαιδρὰν αὐτὴν χορήγει.}
\pl{0.00}{Ἑσπέρα ὥσπερ τῆς ἡμέρας,}
\pl{1.20}{οὕτω καὶ τῆς ζωῆς ἐστι,}
\pl{0.00}{Ἑσπέρα τῆς ζωῆς τὸ γῆρας,}
\pl{2.40}{ἔφθασέ με γῆρας,}
\pl{2.40}{φαιδρὸν αὐτὸ χορήγει.}
\pl{0.00}{Μή με ἀπορρίψῃς εἰς καιρὸν γήρως,}
\pl{1.20}{ἐν τῷ ἐκλείπειν τὴν ἰσχύν μου,}
\pl{2.40}{μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς με.}
\pl{0.00}{Ἕως γήρως ἴσθι σὺ,}
\pl{1.20}{ἕως ἂν καταγηράσω ἀνέχου μου·}
\pl{0.00}{Αὐτὸς ποίησον, καὶ αὐτὸς ἄνες,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ αὐτὸς ἀνάληψαι, καὶ}
\pl{2.40}{σῶσόν με, Κύριε.}
\pl{0.00}{Μεῖνον μετ' ἐμοῦ, Κύριε,}
\pl{1.20}{ἤδη γὰρ πρὸς ἑσπέραν μοι ἐστὶ,}
\pl{0.00}{καὶ κέκλικεν ἡ ἡμέρα}
\pl{1.20}{τῆσδε τῆς πολυμόχθου ζωῆς.}
\pl{0.00}{Τελειωθήτω ἡ δύναμίς σου}
\pl{1.20}{ἐν τῇ ἀσθενείᾳ μου.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ὤχετ' ἀπιοῦσα ἡ ἡμέρα,}
\pl{1.20}{οἴχεται καὶ ὁ βίος,}
\pl{2.40}{ὁ βίος ἄβιος.}

\pglabel{printed 220}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{[THE EVENING OFFICE.]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{NOW that I have passed through the day,}
\pl{1.20}{I give thee thanks, O Lord.}
\pl{2.40}{The evening draweth nigh,}
\pl{1.20}{grant it bright.}
\pl{0.00}{As is the evening of the day,}
\pl{1.20}{so also is the evening of life;}
\pl{0.00}{The evening of life is old age,}
\pl{2.40}{old age hath overtaken me,}
\pl{2.40}{grant it bright.}
\pl{0.00}{Cast me not off in the time of old age;}
\pl{1.20}{when my strength faileth,}
\pl{2.40}{forsake me not.}
\pl{0.00}{Be thou the same even unto old age,}
\pl{1.20}{until I grow grey, bear thou with me;}
\pl{0.00}{Do thou it thyself, and thyself bear me,}
\pl{1.20}{and thyself take me up, and}
\pl{2.40}{save me, O Lord.}
\pl{0.00}{Abide with me, O Lord,}
\pl{1.20}{for it is now toward evening with me,}
\pl{0.00}{and the day is far spent}
\pl{1.20}{of this toilsome life.}
\pl{0.00}{Let thy power be made perfect}
\pl{1.20}{in my weakness.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{The day is gone and passed away,}
\pl{1.20}{and life too passeth,}
\pl{2.40}{life that is no life.}
}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{Night cometh,}

\pl{0.00}{O LORD,}

\pl{1.20}{so also do we add sin upon sin.}

\pl{2.40}{in thy goodness.}

\pl{2.40}{my rising-up,}
\pl{1.20}{from this time forth and even for evermore.}
\pl{0.00}{To be mindful of thee upon my bed,}
\pl{1.20}{to search out my spirit,}
\pl{2.40}{to awake, and}
\pl{2.40}{to be still with thee.}
\pl{0.00}{In peace will I both lay me down,}
\pl{2.40}{and sleep;}
\pl{1.20}{for thou, Lord, only,}
\pl{2.40}{shalt make me dwell in hope.}

\pglabel{printed 244}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{Remembering therefore, O Master, we also,}
\pl{0.00}{in the presence of thy holy Mysteries,}
\pl{1.20}{the saving sufferings of thy Christ,}
\pl{2.40}{the life-giving Cross,}
\pl{2.40}{the most precious Death,}
\pl{2.40}{the three-days' Burial,}
\pl{2.40}{the Resurrection from the dead,}
\pl{2.40}{the Ascension into the heavens,}
\pl{2.40}{the Sitting at thy right hand, O Father,}
\pl{2.40}{his glorious and fearful}
\pl{2.40}{coming again,}
\pl{0.00}{We beseech thee, O Lord,}
\pl{2.40}{that in the pure witness}
\pl{3.60}{of our conscience}
\pl{1.20}{receiving the portion}
\pl{2.40}{of thy hallowed gifts,}
\pl{0.00}{we may be made one with the holy Body and Blood}
\pl{2.40}{of thy Christ;}
\pl{1.20}{and receiving them not unworthily,}
\pl{2.40}{may have Christ dwelling}
\pl{3.60}{in our hearts,}
\pl{1.20}{and may become a temple of thy Holy}
\pl{2.40}{Spirit;}
\pl{2.40}{Yea, O our God.}
\pl{0.00}{And make thou none of us guilty}
\pl{1.20}{of these thy dread and}
\pl{2.40}{heavenly Mysteries,}
\pl{0.00}{neither weak in soul or body,}
\pl{1.20}{through partaking of them}
\pl{2.40}{unworthily.}
}

\parasep
\pl{0.00}{ΠΑΤΕΡ ἄναρχε, Υἱὲ μονογενὴς,}

\pl{2.40}{Θεὸς μετανοούντων,}
\pl{2.40}{Σωτὴρ ἁμαρτανόντων·}
\pl{0.00}{Ἥμαρτον ἐναντίον σου, Κύριε,}
\pl{1.20}{Καὶ οὕτω καὶ οὕτως ἐποίησα.}
\pl{2.40}{Ἔα, ἔα. Φεῦ, φεῦ.}
\pl{0.00}{Πῶς ἐδελεαζόμην ὑπὸ τῆς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας;}
\pl{1.20}{Πῶς ἐμίσησα παιδείαν;}
\pl{0.00}{Καὶ οὐκ ηὐλαβήθην, οὔτ' ᾐδεόμην,}
\pl{2.40}{τὸ ἀκατάληπτον τῆς δόξης,}
\pl{2.40}{τὸ αἰδέσιμον τῆς παρουσίας,}
\pl{2.40}{τὸ φοβερὸν τῆς δυνάμεως,}
\pl{2.40}{τὸ ἀκριβὲς τῆς δικαιοσύνης,}
\pl{2.40}{τὸ προσφιλὲς τῆς ἀγαθωσύνης.}
\pl{0.00}{Ἐπικαλέσομαι, εἴτις μοι ὑπακούσεται,}
\pl{1.20}{Εἰς τίνα ἀγγέλων ἁγίων ὄψομαι;}
\pl{2.40}{Ταλαίπωρος ἐγὼ ἄνθρωπος!}
\pl{0.00}{Τίς με ῥύσεται ἐκ τοῦ σώματος τοῦ θανάτου τούτου;}

\pglabel{printed 252}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{MEDITATION I.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{OF THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O FATHER without beginning, O only-begotten Son,}
\pl{2.40}{O quickening Spirit,}
\pl{1.20}{pitiful, merciful, longsuffering,}
\pl{2.40}{of great mercy, of many tender compassions,}
\pl{1.20}{who lovest the righteous, and hast mercy on sinners,}
\pl{1.20}{who passest over sins, and grantest petitions,}
\pl{2.40}{God of them that repent,}
\pl{2.40}{Saviour of them that sin;}
\pl{0.00}{I have sinned before thee, O Lord,}
\pl{1.20}{and thus and thus have I done.}
\pl{2.40}{Ah, ah! alas, alas!}
\pl{0.00}{How was I enticed by mine own lust?}
\pl{1.20}{How did I hate instruction?}
\pl{0.00}{And I neither reverenced, nor stood in awe of,}
\pl{2.40}{the incomprehensibleness of thy glory,}
\pl{2.40}{the awfulness of thy presence,}
\pl{2.40}{the terribleness of thy power,}
\pl{2.40}{the exactness of thy justice,}
\pl{2.40}{the loveliness of thy goodness.}
\pl{0.00}{I will call, if there be any that will answer me;}
\pl{1.20}{to which of the holy angels shall I look?}
\pl{2.40}{O wretched man that I am!}
\pl{0.00}{Who shall deliver me from the body of this death?}
}

\sectionhead{§1 *Duo in me cognosco*}

\pglabel{printed 267}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{DUO in me cognosco, Domine,}
\pl{2.40}{Naturam, quam Tu fecisti,}
\pl{2.40}{Peccatum, quod ego adjeci;}
\pl{0.00}{Fateor quod per culpam deformavi naturam,}
\pl{1.20}{sed memento quod sum spiritus vadens,}
\pl{3.60}{non rediens;\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Psal.} lxxviii. 39.]}
\pl{0.00}{Per meipsum enim a peccato redire non possum.}
\pl{2.40}{Eja! tolle a me quod ego feci,}
\pl{2.40}{Remaneat in me quod Tu fecisti;}
\pl{0.00}{Ut ne pereat, quod pretioso Tuo sanguine redemisti.}
\pl{2.40}{Eja! ne perdat improbitas mea, quod redemit boni-}
\pl{3.60}{tas Tua.}
\pl{0.00}{Domine, Deus mi, si feci, ut essem reus Tuus,}
\pl{0.00}{Nunquid facere potui, ut non essem servus Tuus?}
\pl{0.00}{Si inde innocentiam mihi ademi,}
\pl{0.00}{Nunquid et inde misericordiam Tuam peremi?}
\pl{0.00}{Si commisi, unde me damnare posses,}
\pl{0.00}{Nunquid et Tu amisisti, unde salvare soles?}
\pl{0.00}{Verum est, Domine, conscientia mea meretur damnationem,}
\pl{1.20}{Sed misericordia Tua superat omnem offensionem.}

\pglabel{printed 267}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{TWO things I know in myself, O Lord,}
\pl{2.40}{The nature, which Thou madest,}
\pl{2.40}{The sin, which I have added thereto;}
\pl{0.00}{I confess that by my fault I have marred the nature,}
\pl{1.20}{but remember that I am a wind that passeth away,}
\pl{3.60}{and cometh not again;\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 78:39]}
\pl{0.00}{For of myself I cannot come back from sin.}
\pl{2.40}{O come! take from me what I have done,}
\pl{2.40}{Let there abide in me what Thou hast done;}
\pl{0.00}{That it perish not, which Thou hast redeemed with Thy precious blood.}
\pl{2.40}{O come! let not my wickedness destroy what Thy good-}
\pl{3.60}{ness hath redeemed.}
\pl{0.00}{O Lord my God, if I have wrought that I should be guilty before Thee,}
\pl{0.00}{Could I ever have wrought that I should not be Thy servant?}
\pl{0.00}{If thereby I have taken innocence from myself,}
\pl{0.00}{Have I thereby also made an end of Thy mercy?}
\pl{0.00}{If I have committed that whereby Thou couldest condemn me,}
\pl{0.00}{Hast Thou also lost that whereby Thou art wont to save?}
\pl{0.00}{It is true, O Lord, my conscience deserveth damnation,}
\pl{1.20}{But Thy mercy surpasseth every offence.}
}

\pl{0.00}{SACRIFICIUM VESPERTINUM.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{MEMOR sim nocte nominis Tui, et legem}
\pl{1.20}{Tuam custodiam.\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Psal.} cxix. 55.]}
\pl{0.00}{Vespertina oratio ascendat ad Te,}
\pl{1.20}{et descendat ad nos miseratio Tua,}
\pl{0.00}{Qui das carmina de nocte,\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Job.} xxxv. 10.]}
\pl{2.40}{Qui facis ut exitus Auroræ et Vesperi dilaudent Te,}
\pl{3.60}{[\emph{Psal.} lxv. 8.]}
\pl{0.00}{Qui das dilectis Tuis somnum sanitatis.\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Ps.} cxxvii. 3.]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{HOROLOGIUM.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Qui tempora et momenta posuisti in potestate Tua,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Act.} i. 7.}
\pl{0.00}{Largire, ut tempore commodo et opportuno oremus Te,}
\pl{1.20}{\emph{Mar.} iv. 38.}
\pl{4.80}{Et serva nos.}
\pl{0.00}{Qui propter nos homines, et propter salutem nostram,}
\pl{1.20}{Alta nocte natus es,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Luc.} ii. 8.}
\pl{0.00}{Da nobis renasci indies renovatione Spiritus Sancti,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Tit.} iii. 5.}
\pl{0.00}{Donec Christus formetur in nobis, in virum perfectum,}
\pl{1.20}{\emph{Gal.} iv. 19.\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Eph.} iv. 13.]}
\pl{4.80}{Et serva nos.}
\pl{0.00}{Qui mane primo Oriente jam sole}
\pl{1.20}{resurrexisti a mortuis,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Mar.} xvi. 2.}
\pl{0.00}{Resuscita nos quotidie ad vitæ novitatem,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Rom.} vi. 4.}
\pl{0.00}{Suggerens nobis, quos Ipse nosti, modos pœnitentiæ,}
\pl{4.80}{Et serva nos.}

\pglabel{printed 286}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{THE EVENING SACRIFICE.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Let me remember Thy Name in the night, and}
\pl{1.20}{keep Thy law.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 119:55]}
\pl{0.00}{Let my evening prayer ascend unto Thee,}
\pl{1.20}{and let Thy compassion descend upon us,}
\pl{0.00}{Who givest songs in the night,\hspace{0.90em}[Job 35:10]}
\pl{2.40}{Who makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to praise Thee,}
\pl{3.60}{[Ps. 65:8]}
\pl{0.00}{Who givest Thy beloved the sleep of health.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 127:3]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{THE HOURS.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Who hast put the times and the moments in Thine own power,\hspace{0.90em}[Acts 1:7]}
\pl{0.00}{Grant that in fit and seasonable time we may pray unto Thee,\hspace{0.90em}[Mark 4:38]}
\pl{4.80}{And save us.}
\pl{0.00}{Who for us men, and for our salvation,}
\pl{1.20}{wast born in the deep of night,\hspace{0.90em}[Luke 2:8]}
\pl{0.00}{Grant us to be born again day by day by the renewing of the Holy Ghost,\hspace{0.90em}[Titus 3:5]}
\pl{0.00}{until Christ be formed in us, unto a perfect man,\hspace{0.90em}[Gal. 4:19 / Eph. 4:13]}
\pl{4.80}{And save us.}
\pl{0.00}{Who in the early morning, the sun now risen,}
\pl{1.20}{didst rise again from the dead,\hspace{0.90em}[Mark 16:2]}
\pl{0.00}{Raise us daily unto newness of life,\hspace{0.90em}[Rom. 6:4]}
\pl{0.00}{Suggesting to us — Thou Thyself knowest them — the ways of repentance,}
\pl{4.80}{And save us.}
}

\pglabel{printed 287}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{Qui hora tertia Spiritum Sanctum Tuum}
\pl{1.20}{in Apostolos demisisti,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Act.} ii. 15.}
\pl{0.00}{Eundem Spiritum ne auferas a nobis,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} li. 11.}
\pl{2.40}{Sed quotidie renova in visceribus nostris,}
\pl{4.80}{Et serva nos.}
\pl{0.00}{Qui hora sexta dieque sexto tecum una in cruce suffixisti}
\pl{1.20}{peccata mundi,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Matt.} xxvii. 45.}
\pl{0.00}{Dele quod adversum nos est Chirographum}
\pl{1.20}{peccatorum nostrorum, et, tollens de medio,\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Col.} ii. 14.]}
\pl{4.80}{Serva nos.}
\pl{0.00}{Qui hora sexta linteum magnum de cœlo}
\pl{1.20}{submisisti ad terram, Ecclesiæ Tuæ symbolum,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Act.} x. [9,] 11.}
\pl{0.00}{Recipe nos in illud peccatores de gentibus,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Gal.} ii. 15.}
\pl{2.40}{Et cum illa recipe una in cœlum,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Act.} x. 16.}
\pl{4.80}{Et serva nos.}
\pl{0.00}{Qui hora septima Reguli filium a febre}
\pl{1.20}{relinqui voluisti,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Jo.} iv. 52.}
\pl{0.00}{Siquid in anima nostra febrile hæreat,}
\pl{1.20}{aut morbidum, aufer a nobis etiam,}
\pl{4.80}{Et serva nos.}
\pl{0.00}{Qui hora nona propter nos peccatores et peccata nostra}
\pl{1.20}{mortem gustasti,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Mar.} xv. 34.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Heb.} ii. 9.}
\pl{0.00}{Mortifica in nobis membra terrena,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Col.} iii. 5.}
\pl{2.40}{Et quicquid voluntati Tuæ adversum est,}
\pl{4.80}{Et serva nos.}
\pl{0.00}{Qui horam nonam orationis horam esse voluisti,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Act.} iii. 1.}
\pl{0.00}{Orantes nos in hora orationis exaudi,}
\pl{1.20}{Et orationis votique nos compotes redde,}
\pl{4.80}{Et serva nos.}
\pl{0.00}{Qui hora decima ab Apostolo Tuo, invento Filio Tuo,}

\pglabel{printed 287}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{Who at the third hour didst send down Thy Holy}
\pl{1.20}{Spirit upon the Apostles,\hspace{0.90em}[Acts 2:15]}
\pl{0.00}{Take not the same Spirit from us,\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 51:11]}
\pl{2.40}{But daily renew Him within our inward parts,}
\pl{4.80}{And save us.}
\pl{0.00}{Who at the sixth hour, and on the sixth day, didst nail up with Thee on the cross}
\pl{1.20}{the sins of the world,\hspace{0.90em}[Matt. 27:45]}
\pl{0.00}{Blot out the handwriting that is against us,}
\pl{1.20}{the handwriting of our sins, and, taking it out of the way,\hspace{0.90em}[Col. 2:14]}
\pl{4.80}{Save us.}
\pl{0.00}{Who at the sixth hour a great sheet from heaven}
\pl{1.20}{didst let down to earth, the emblem of Thy Church,\hspace{0.90em}[Acts 10:9,11]}
\pl{0.00}{Receive us into it, sinners of the Gentiles,\hspace{0.90em}[Gal. 2:15]}
\pl{2.40}{And with it receive us together into heaven,\hspace{0.90em}[Acts 10:16]}
\pl{4.80}{And save us.}
\pl{0.00}{Who at the seventh hour didst will the nobleman's son}
\pl{1.20}{to be left of the fever,\hspace{0.90em}[John 4:52]}
\pl{0.00}{If aught feverish cleave in our soul,}
\pl{1.20}{or diseased, take it also from us,}
\pl{4.80}{And save us.}
\pl{0.00}{Who at the ninth hour, for us sinners and for our sins,}
\pl{1.20}{didst taste death,\hspace{0.90em}[Mark 15:34 / Heb. 2:9]}
\pl{0.00}{Mortify in us our earthly members,\hspace{0.90em}[Col. 3:5]}
\pl{2.40}{And whatsoever is contrary to Thy will,}
\pl{4.80}{And save us.}
\pl{0.00}{Who didst will the ninth hour to be the hour of prayer,\hspace{0.90em}[Acts 3:1]}
\pl{0.00}{Hear us praying in the hour of prayer,}
\pl{1.20}{And make us to obtain our prayer and our vow,}
\pl{4.80}{And save us.}
\pl{0.00}{Who at the tenth hour, by Thine Apostle, when he had found Thy Son,}
}

\pl{1.20}{cum ingenti gaudio,}

\pl{0.00}{Et nos eundem Messiam similiter invenire,}
\pl{1.20}{Et invento similiter gaudere fac,}
\pl{4.80}{Et serva nos.}
\pl{0.00}{Qui stantes toto die otiosos dignatus es tamen}

\pl{4.80}{Et serva nos.}

\pl{1.20}{sed quoad remissionem, ne ad retentionem, Domine,}

\pl{1.20}{with exceeding joy,}
\pl{1.20}{didst will it to be proclaimed, "We have found the Messias,"\hspace{0.90em}[John 1:41]}

\pl{1.20}{and likewise, having found Him, to rejoice,}
\pl{4.80}{And save us.}
\pl{0.00}{Who, though we stood idle all the day, didst yet vouchsafe,}

\pl{0.00}{Do the same grace unto us,}
\pl{1.20}{And, though late, as it were about the eleventh hour,\hspace{0.90em}[v. 9]}

\pl{4.80}{And save us.}
\pl{0.00}{Who at the hour of the Supper didst will to institute}
\pl{1.20}{the holy mysteries of Thy Body and Blood,\hspace{0.90em}[John 13:2]}

\pl{1.20}{judgment, but unto remission of sin, and to obtain the bequests}

\pl{0.00}{Who in the evening didst will to be taken from the cross, and in the tomb}
\pl{1.20}{to be buried,\hspace{0.90em}[Mark 15:42]}
\pl{0.00}{Take from us, and bury in Thy sepulchre,}
\pl{1.20}{our sins, covering with good works}
\pl{2.40}{whatsoever we have done amiss,}
\pl{4.80}{And save us.}

\pl{0.00}{Who at midnight didst rouse David Thy Prophet,\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 119:62]}

\pl{0.00}{Give us also songs in the night,\hspace{0.90em}[Job 35:10]}

\pl{0.00}{Who at midnight, that the Bridegroom should come,}

\pl{0.00}{Grant that the cry may ever sound in our ears,}

\pl{0.00}{That we may never be unprepared}
\pl{2.40}{to meet Him,}
\pl{4.80}{And save us.}
\pl{0.00}{Who at cock-crow didst warn Thine Apostle,}
\pl{1.20}{and madest him return unto repentance,\hspace{0.90em}[Matt. 26:74]}
\pl{0.00}{Grant us also, at the same warning, to do the like,}

\sectionhead{§7 *Allegatio* (the Pleading)}

\pglabel{printed 291}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{ALLEGATIO.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[I.] EX PARTE DEI.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[1.] \emph{Natura Dei.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Quia miserator et misericors Dominus, longanimis et}
\pl{1.20}{multum misericors;}
\pl{0.00}{Non in perpetuum irascetur, neque in æternum com-}
\pl{1.20}{minabitur.}
\pl{0.00}{Non secundum peccata nostra fecit nobis,}
\pl{1.20}{neque secundum iniquitates nostras retribuit nobis.}
\pl{0.00}{Quoniam secundum altitudinem cœli a terra, corroboravit}
\pl{1.20}{misericordiam suam super timentes Eum.}
\pl{0.00}{Quantum distat ortus ab occidente, longe fecit a nobis}
\pl{1.20}{iniquitates nostras.}
\pl{0.00}{Quomodo miseretur pater filiorum, misertus est Dominus}
\pl{1.20}{timentibus Eum.\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Psal.} ciii. 8[—12.]]}
\pl{0.00}{Quia suavis, et mitis, et multæ misericordiæ est omnibus}
\pl{1.20}{invocantibus Eum.\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Psal.} lxxxvi. 5.]}
\pl{0.00}{Suavis Dominus universis, et miserationes Ejus super}
\pl{1.20}{omnia opera Ejus.\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Psal.} cxlv. 9.]}
\pl{0.00}{Quia volens misericordiam est.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Mich.} vii. 18.}
\pl{0.00}{Pater est misericordiæ.\hspace{0.90em}2 \emph{Cor.} i. 3.}
\pl{0.00}{Misericordia est.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} lix. 17.}
\pl{0.00}{Cui \{ misereri opus proprium, / punire opus alienum et peregrinum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Is.} xxviii. 21. \}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[2.] \emph{Nomen Dei.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Magnificetur virtus Domini, sicut proclamavit, dicens,}

\pglabel{printed 291}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{THE PLEADING.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[I.] ON GOD'S PART.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[1.] \emph{The Nature of God.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Because the Lord is full of compassion and mercy, long-suffering, and}
\pl{1.20}{of great goodness;}
\pl{0.00}{He will not alway be chiding, neither keepeth He His anger}
\pl{1.20}{for ever.}
\pl{0.00}{He hath not dealt with us after our sins,}
\pl{1.20}{nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.}
\pl{0.00}{For as the heaven is high above the earth, so greatly hath He set}
\pl{1.20}{His mercy over them that fear Him.}
\pl{0.00}{As far as the east is from the west, so far hath He set from us}
\pl{1.20}{our iniquities.}
\pl{0.00}{Like as a father pitieth his children, so is the Lord merciful}
\pl{1.20}{unto them that fear Him.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 103:8–12]}
\pl{0.00}{Because He is gracious, and gentle, and of great mercy unto all}
\pl{1.20}{that call upon Him.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 86:5]}
\pl{0.00}{The Lord is loving unto every man, and His mercy is over}
\pl{1.20}{all His works.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 145:9]}
\pl{0.00}{Because He delighteth in mercy.\hspace{0.90em}[Mic. 7:18]}
\pl{0.00}{He is the Father of mercies.\hspace{0.90em}[2 Cor. 1:3]}
\pl{0.00}{He is Mercy itself.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 59:17]}
\pl{0.00}{To whom \{ to shew mercy is His proper work, / to punish His strange and alien work. \}\hspace{0.90em}[Isa. 28:21]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[2.] \emph{The Name of God.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Let the power of the Lord be magnified, according as He proclaimed, saying,}
}

\pglabel{printed 292}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{Dominus patiens et multæ misericordiæ, auferens ini-}
\pl{1.20}{quitatem et scelera.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Num.} xiv. [17,] 18.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[3.] \emph{Nomen Patris.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ascendo ad Patrem Meum,}
\pl{2.40}{et Patrem vestrum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Jo.} xx. 17.}
\pl{0.00}{Pater filii prodigi.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Luc.} xv. 20.}
\pl{1.20}{Et quid fiet nomini magno Tuo?\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Josh.} vii. 9.]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[4.] \emph{Nomen Christi.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Agnus in typo.\hspace{0.60em}Ecce Agnus Dei!\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Jo.} i. 29.}
\pl{0.00}{Redemptor.\hspace{0.60em}Scio quod Redemptor meus vivit.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Job.} xix. 25.}
\pl{0.00}{Servator.\hspace{0.60em}Scimus quia hic est vere Salvator mundi.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Jo.} iv. 42.}
\pl{0.00}{Mediator.\hspace{0.60em}Unus Mediator Dei et hominum.\hspace{0.90em}1 \emph{Tim.} ii. 5.}
\pl{0.00}{Advocatus.\hspace{0.60em}Advocatum habemus apud Patrem.\hspace{0.90em}1 \emph{Jo.} ii. 1.}
\pl{1.20}{Intercessor.\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Heb.} vii. 25.]}
\pl{1.20}{Pontifex.\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Vers.} 26.]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[5.] \emph{Nomen Spiritus Sancti.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Columba in typo.\hspace{0.60em}Vidit Spiritum Dei descendentem}
\pl{1.20}{sicut columbam.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Matt.} iii. 16.}
\pl{0.00}{Unguentum, sive Unctio.\hspace{0.60em}Sicut Unctio vos docet.\hspace{0.90em}1 \emph{Jo.} ii. 27.}
\pl{0.00}{Consolator.\hspace{0.60em}Si non abiero, Paracletus non veniet.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Jo.} xvi. 7.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[6.] \emph{Promissum Dei.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Memor esto verbi Tui servo Tuo, in quo mihi spem}
\pl{1.20}{dedisti,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} cxix. 49.}
\pl{0.00}{Quam promisit qui non mentitur Deus,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Tit.} i. 2.}
\pl{0.00}{Interposito jurejurando,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Heb.} vi. 17.}

\pglabel{printed 292}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy, taking away}
\pl{1.20}{iniquity and transgression.\hspace{0.90em}[Num. 14:17,18]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[3.] \emph{The Name of the Father.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{I ascend unto My Father,}
\pl{2.40}{and your Father.\hspace{0.90em}[John 20:17]}
\pl{0.00}{The Father of the prodigal son.\hspace{0.90em}[Luke 15:20]}
\pl{1.20}{And what wilt Thou do unto Thy great Name?\hspace{0.90em}[Josh. 7:9]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[4.] \emph{The Name of Christ.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{The Lamb, in figure.\hspace{0.60em}Behold the Lamb of God!\hspace{0.90em}[John 1:29]}
\pl{0.00}{Redeemer.\hspace{0.60em}I know that my Redeemer liveth.\hspace{0.90em}[Job 19:25]}
\pl{0.00}{Saviour.\hspace{0.60em}We know that this is indeed the Saviour of the world.\hspace{0.90em}[John 4:42]}
\pl{0.00}{Mediator.\hspace{0.60em}One Mediator between God and men.\hspace{0.90em}[1 Tim. 2:5]}
\pl{0.00}{Advocate.\hspace{0.60em}We have an Advocate with the Father.\hspace{0.90em}[1 John 2:1]}
\pl{1.20}{Intercessor.\hspace{0.90em}[Heb. 7:25]}
\pl{1.20}{High Priest.\hspace{0.90em}[v. 26]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[5.] \emph{The Name of the Holy Spirit.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{The Dove, in figure.\hspace{0.60em}He saw the Spirit of God descending}
\pl{1.20}{like a dove.\hspace{0.90em}[Matt. 3:16]}
\pl{0.00}{The Ointment, or Unction.\hspace{0.60em}As the Unction teacheth you.\hspace{0.90em}[1 John 2:27]}
\pl{0.00}{Comforter.\hspace{0.60em}If I go not away, the Paraclete will not come.\hspace{0.90em}[John 16:7]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[6.] \emph{The Promise of God.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Remember Thy word unto Thy servant, wherein Thou hast caused me}
\pl{1.20}{to put my trust,\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 119:49]}
\pl{0.00}{Which God, that cannot lie, hath promised,\hspace{0.90em}[Titus 1:2]}
\pl{0.00}{confirming it by an oath,\hspace{0.90em}[Heb. 6:17]}
}

\pglabel{printed 293}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{Cujus fidem incredulitas hominum}
\pl{1.20}{non evacuabit.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Rom.} iii. 3.}
\pl{0.00}{Quod si non credimus, Ipse fidelis permanet, seipsum}
\pl{1.20}{negare non potest.\hspace{0.90em}2 \emph{Tim.} ii. 13.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[7.] \emph{Praxis Dei.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{In Te sperarunt patres nostri; speraverunt, et liberasti}
\pl{1.20}{eos.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} xxii. 4.}
\pl{0.00}{Reminiscere miserationum Tuarum, Domine, et miseri-}
\pl{1.20}{cordiarum Tuarum quæ a sæculo sunt.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Ps.} xxv. 5.}
\pl{0.00}{Ubi sunt misericordiæ Tuæ antiquæ, Domine?\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Ps.} lxxxix. 48.}
\pl{0.00}{Respicite, filii, nationes hominum, et scitote, quia nullus}
\pl{1.20}{speravit in Domino, et confusus est.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Syr.} [i. e. \emph{Ecclus.}] ii. 11.}
\pl{0.00}{Quis enim permansit in mandatis Ejus, et derelictus}
\pl{1.20}{est?\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Vers.} 12.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{ALLEGATIO.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[II.] EX PARTE NOSTRA, RELATIVE AD DEUM.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[1.] \emph{Opus et creatio manuum Suarum.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Opus manuum Tuarum ne despicias.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} cxxxviii. 8.}
\pl{0.00}{Nos lutum, et figulus noster Tu, et opera manuum}
\pl{1.20}{Tuarum omnes nos.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Is.} lxiv. 8.}
\pl{0.00}{Nihil odisti eorum quæ fecisti.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Sap.} xi. 25.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[2.] \emph{Imago vultus.}\hspace{0.90em}Ne deleas.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Faciamus hominem ad imaginem,}
\pl{1.20}{et similitudinem nostram.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Gen.} i. 26.}

\pglabel{printed 293}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{Whose faithfulness the unbelief of men}
\pl{1.20}{shall not make void.\hspace{0.90em}[Rom. 3:3]}
\pl{0.00}{For if we believe not, yet He abideth faithful, He cannot}
\pl{1.20}{deny Himself.\hspace{0.90em}[2 Tim. 2:13]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[7.] \emph{The Practice of God.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Our fathers hoped in Thee; they trusted, and Thou didst deliver}
\pl{1.20}{them.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 22:4]}
\pl{0.00}{Call to remembrance, O Lord, Thy tender mercies, and Thy}
\pl{1.20}{loving-kindnesses, which have been ever of old.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 25:5]}
\pl{0.00}{Where are Thine old loving-kindnesses, O Lord?\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 89:48]}
\pl{0.00}{Look, my children, at the generations of men, and know that never any}
\pl{1.20}{hoped in the Lord, and was confounded.\hspace{0.90em}[Ecclus. 2:11]}
\pl{0.00}{For who ever continued in His commandments, and was}
\pl{1.20}{forsaken?\hspace{0.90em}[v. 12]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{THE PLEADING.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[II.] ON OUR PART, IN RELATION TO GOD.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[1.] \emph{The Work and Creation of His Hands.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Despise not the work of Thine own hands.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 138:8]}
\pl{0.00}{We are the clay, and Thou our potter, and we all are the work of}
\pl{1.20}{Thy hands.\hspace{0.90em}[Isa. 64:8]}
\pl{0.00}{Thou hatest nothing that Thou hast made.\hspace{0.90em}[Wisd. 11:25]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[2.] \emph{The Image of Thy Face.}\hspace{0.90em}Blot it not out.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Let us make man after the image,}
\pl{1.20}{and likeness of Ourselves.\hspace{0.90em}[Gen. 1:26]}
}

\pglabel{printed 294}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{Qui renovatur in agnitionem, secundum imaginem Ejus}
\pl{1.20}{qui creavit illum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Coloss.} iii. 10.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[3.] \emph{Pretium sanguinis.}\hspace{0.90em}Ne vilipendas.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Empti estis pretio magno,\hspace{0.90em}1 \emph{Cor.} vi. 20.}
\pl{0.00}{Pretioso sanguine Agni immaculati,}
\pl{2.40}{et incontaminati.\hspace{0.90em}1 \emph{Pet.} i. 19.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[4.] \emph{Invocatio nominis.}\hspace{0.90em}Passive.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Characterem ne contemnas,}
\pl{0.00}{Nomen Tuum invocatum est super nos.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Jer.} xiv. 9.}
\pl{0.00}{Quia nomen Tuum invocatum est super populum Tuum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Dan.} ix. 19.}
\pl{0.00}{Vas, ut portet nomen Tuum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Act.} ix. 15.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[5.] \emph{Membrum Corporis Christi.}\hspace{0.90em}Ne præscindas.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Vos estis corpus Christi, et membra de membro.\hspace{0.90em}1 \emph{Cor.} xii. 27.}
\pl{0.00}{Nescitis, quoniam corpora vestra membra sunt Christi?\hspace{0.90em}1 \emph{Cor.} vi. 15.}
\pl{0.00}{An nescitis, quoniam membra vestra templum sunt}
\pl{1.20}{Spiritus Sancti, qui in vobis est?\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Vers.} 19.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[6.] \emph{Proprietas in Christo.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Tuus sum ego, salvum me fac.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} cxix. 94.}
\pl{0.00}{Ecce, Domine, quia ego servus Tuus,}
\pl{1.20}{ego servus Tuus, et filius ancillæ Tuæ.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Ps.} cxvi. 16.}
\pl{0.00}{Populus Tuus omnes nos.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Is.} lxiv. 9.}
\pl{0.00}{Non ad Te pertinet, si perimus?\hspace{0.60em}Imo pertinet.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Mar.} iv. 38.}
\pl{0.00}{Servus inutilis, servus tamen.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Luc.} xvii. 10.}
\pl{0.00}{Filius perditus, tamen filius.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Luc.} xv. 24.}

\pglabel{printed 294}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{Which is renewed in knowledge, after the image of Him}
\pl{1.20}{that created him.\hspace{0.90em}[Col. 3:10]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[3.] \emph{The Price of Thy Blood.}\hspace{0.90em}Set it not at nought.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ye are bought with a great price,\hspace{0.90em}[1 Cor. 6:20]}
\pl{0.00}{With the precious blood of the Lamb without blemish,}
\pl{2.40}{and without spot.\hspace{0.90em}[1 Pet. 1:19]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[4.] \emph{The Invocation of Thy Name.}\hspace{0.90em}(Passively borne.)}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Despise not the mark [Thou hast set],}
\pl{0.00}{Thy Name is called upon us.\hspace{0.90em}[Jer. 14:9]}
\pl{0.00}{For Thy Name is called upon Thy people.\hspace{0.90em}[Dan. 9:19]}
\pl{0.00}{A vessel, to bear Thy Name.\hspace{0.90em}[Acts 9:15]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[5.] \emph{A Member of the Body of Christ.}\hspace{0.90em}Cut it not off.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.\hspace{0.90em}[1 Cor. 12:27]}
\pl{0.00}{Know ye not, that your bodies are the members of Christ?\hspace{0.90em}[1 Cor. 6:15]}
\pl{0.00}{Know ye not, that your members are the temple of}
\pl{1.20}{the Holy Ghost, which is in you?\hspace{0.90em}[v. 19]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[6.] \emph{A Possession in Christ.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{I am Thine, O save me.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 119:94]}
\pl{0.00}{Behold, O Lord, for I am Thy servant,}
\pl{1.20}{I am Thy servant, and the son of Thine handmaid.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 116:16]}
\pl{0.00}{We all are Thy people.\hspace{0.90em}[Isa. 64:9]}
\pl{0.00}{Carest Thou not that we perish?\hspace{0.60em}Nay, Thou carest.\hspace{0.90em}[Mark 4:38]}
\pl{0.00}{An unprofitable servant, yet a servant.\hspace{0.90em}[Luke 17:10]}
\pl{0.00}{A lost son, yet a son.\hspace{0.90em}[Luke 15:24]}
}

\pglabel{printed 295}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{ALLEGATIO.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[III.] EX PARTE NOSTRA, QUOAD NOS.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[1.] \emph{Infirmitas Naturæ.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Quoniam infirmus sum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} vi. 2.}
\pl{0.00}{Memorare quæ mea substantia.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} lxxxix. 47.}
\pl{0.00}{Et recordatus est, quia caro sunt,}
\pl{1.20}{spiritus vadens, et non rediens.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} lxxviii. 39.}
\pl{0.00}{Quoniam Ipse cognovit figmentum nostrum,}
\pl{0.00}{Recordatus est, quoniam pulvis sumus.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} ciii. 14.}
\pl{0.00}{Homo sicut fœnum:}
\pl{0.00}{Dies ejus, sicut flos agri, sic efflorescit.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Vers.} 15.}
\pl{0.00}{Quoniam spiritus pertransibit in illo, et non subsistet,}
\pl{1.20}{et non cognoscet amplius locum suum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Vers.} 16.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[2.] \emph{Miseria conditionis.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Miseri facti sumus nimis.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} lxxix. 8.}
\pl{0.00}{Et vidit cum tribularentur,}
\pl{1.20}{et audivit orationem eorum.\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Psal.} cvi.] 44.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[IV.] EX PARTE NOSTRA, QUOAD OFFICIUM.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[1.] \emph{Pœnitentes.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Quia cor contritum et humiliatum,}
\pl{1.20}{Deus, non despicies.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} li. 17.}
\pl{0.00}{Quoniam iniquitatem meam annunciabo,}
\pl{1.20}{et cogitabo pro peccato meo.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} xxxviii. 18.}

\pglabel{printed 295}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{THE PLEADING.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[III.] ON OUR PART, AS CONCERNS OURSELVES.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[1.] \emph{The Weakness of Nature.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{For I am weak.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 6:2]}
\pl{0.00}{Remember how short my time is.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 89:47]}
\pl{0.00}{And He remembered that they were but flesh,}
\pl{1.20}{a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 78:39]}
\pl{0.00}{For He knoweth whereof we are made,}
\pl{0.00}{He remembereth that we are but dust.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 103:14]}
\pl{0.00}{Man is but as grass:}
\pl{0.00}{his days, as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.\hspace{0.90em}[v. 15]}
\pl{0.00}{For the wind goeth over it, and it is gone,}
\pl{1.20}{and the place thereof shall know it no more.\hspace{0.90em}[v. 16]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[2.] \emph{The Misery of our Condition.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{We are brought very low.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 79:8]}
\pl{0.00}{And He saw when they were in adversity,}
\pl{1.20}{and heard their prayer.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 106:44]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[IV.] ON OUR PART, AS CONCERNS OUR DUTY.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[1.] \emph{As penitent.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Because a broken and a contrite heart,}
\pl{1.20}{O God, Thou wilt not despise.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 51:17]}
\pl{0.00}{For I will confess my wickedness,}
\pl{1.20}{and be sorry for my sin.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 38:18]}
}

\pglabel{printed 296}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{[2.] \emph{Supplices.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Quoniam ad Te clamavi tota die.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} lxxxvi. 3.}
\pl{0.00}{Quousque irasceris super orationem servi Tui?\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Ps.} lxxx. 4.]}
\pl{0.00}{Omne debitum dimisi tibi, quoniam rogasti Me.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Matt.} xviii. 32.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[3.] \emph{Quia dimittimus.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Dimittite et dimittemini;\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Luc.} vi. 37.}
\pl{0.00}{Et cum stabitis ad orandum, dimittite,}
\pl{1.20}{siquid habetis adversus aliquem, ut et}
\pl{0.00}{Pater vester, qui est in cœlis, dimittat vobis}
\pl{1.20}{peccata vestra.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Mar.} xi. 25.}
\pl{0.00}{Quod si vos non dimiseritis, nec Pater vester, qui in}
\pl{1.20}{cœlis est, dimittet vobis peccata vestra.\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Vers.} 26.]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[4.] \emph{Quia proponimus deinceps.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Concupivit anima mea desiderare}
\pl{1.20}{justificationes Tuas omni tempore.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} cxix. 20.}
\pl{0.00}{Levabo manus meas ad mandata Tua, quæ dilexi.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Ver.} 48.}
\pl{0.00}{Vovi, et firmiter statui, ut custodiam mandata Tua.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Ver.} 60.}
\pl{0.00}{Qui volunt timere nomen Tuum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Neh.} i. 11.}
\pl{0.00}{Servus plectetur qui neque præparavit,}
\pl{1.20}{neque fecit.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Luc.} xii. 47.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[V.] EX PARTE CONSEQUENTIS MALI.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[1.] \emph{Nihil commodi.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Quæ utilitas in sanguine meo, dum,}
\pl{1.20}{descendo in corruptionem?}
\pl{0.00}{Nunquid confitebitur Tibi pulvis,}

\pglabel{printed 296}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{[2.] \emph{As suppliant.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{For I have called daily upon Thee.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 86:3]}
\pl{0.00}{How long wilt Thou be angry at the prayer of Thy servant?\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 80:4]}
\pl{0.00}{I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst Me.\hspace{0.90em}[Matt. 18:32]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[3.] \emph{Because we forgive.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Forgive, and ye shall be forgiven;\hspace{0.90em}[Luke 6:37]}
\pl{0.00}{And when ye stand praying, forgive,}
\pl{1.20}{if ye have aught against any, that also}
\pl{0.00}{your Father, which is in heaven, may forgive you}
\pl{1.20}{your trespasses.\hspace{0.90em}[Mark 11:25]}
\pl{0.00}{But if ye forgive not, neither will your Father, which is in}
\pl{1.20}{heaven, forgive you your trespasses.\hspace{0.90em}[v. 26]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[4.] \emph{Because we purpose amendment henceforth.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{My soul hath longed to desire}
\pl{1.20}{Thy judgments at all times.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 119:20]}
\pl{0.00}{My hands will I lift up unto Thy commandments, which I have loved.\hspace{0.90em}[v. 48]}
\pl{0.00}{I have sworn, and am stedfastly purposed, to keep Thy commandments.\hspace{0.90em}[v. 60]}
\pl{0.00}{Who desire to fear Thy Name.\hspace{0.90em}[Neh. 1:11]}
\pl{0.00}{The servant shall be beaten who neither prepared himself,}
\pl{1.20}{nor did.\hspace{0.90em}[Luke 12:47]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[V.] ON THE PART OF THE EVIL THAT WOULD FOLLOW.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[1.] \emph{No profit [to God].}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{What profit is there in my blood, when}
\pl{1.20}{I go down to corruption?}
\pl{0.00}{Shall the dust give thanks unto Thee,}
}

\pglabel{printed 297}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{aut annunciabit veritatem Tuam?\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} xxx. 9.}
\pl{0.00}{Quoniam non est in morte, qui memor sit Tui; in in-}
\pl{1.20}{ferno, qui confitebitur Tibi.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} vi. 5.}
\pl{0.00}{Nunquid mortuis facies mirabilia?}
\pl{1.20}{Aut mortui suscitabuntur, et confitebuntur Tibi?\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} lxxxviii. 10.}
\pl{0.00}{Nunquid narrabit aliquis in sepulcro}
\pl{1.20}{misericordiam Tuam, et veritatem}
\pl{2.40}{in pulvere?\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Vers.} 11.}
\pl{0.00}{Nunquid cognoscentur in tenebris mirabilia Tua, et jus-}
\pl{1.20}{titia Tua in terra oblivionis?\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Vers.} 12.}
\pl{0.00}{Quia non infernus confitebitur Tibi, neque mors laudabit}
\pl{1.20}{Te.\hspace{0.60em}Non expectabunt, qui descendunt in lacum, veri-}
\pl{1.20}{tatem Tuam.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Is.} xxxviii. 18.}
\pl{0.00}{Vivens, vivens, ipse confitebitur Tibi.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Vers.} 19.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[2.] \emph{Frustra.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Nunquid vane constituisti omnes filios hominum?\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} lxxxix. 46.}
\pl{0.00}{Ne intres in judicium cum servo Tuo, quia non justifi-}
\pl{1.20}{cabitur in conspectu Tuo}
\pl{2.40}{omnis vivens.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} cxliii. 2.}
\pl{0.00}{Si iniquitates observaveris, Domine, Domine, quis sustine-}
\pl{1.20}{bit?\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} cxxx. 3.}
\pl{0.00}{Si voluerit contendere cum eo, non poterit}
\pl{1.20}{ei respondere unum pro mille.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Job.} ix. 3.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[3.] \emph{Triumphus hostium.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ne des hæreditatem Tuam in opprobrium,}
\pl{1.20}{ut dominentur ei Nationes.\hspace{0.60em}Quare dicunt in populis,}
\pl{1.20}{Ubi est Deus eorum?\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Joel.} ii. 17.]}

\pglabel{printed 297}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{or declare Thy truth?\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 30:9]}
\pl{0.00}{For in death no man remembereth Thee; in the}
\pl{1.20}{grave who shall give Thee thanks?\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 6:5]}
\pl{0.00}{Wilt Thou shew wonders to the dead?}
\pl{1.20}{Or shall the dead rise up again, and praise Thee?\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 88:10]}
\pl{0.00}{Shall any tell of Thy loving-kindness in the grave,}
\pl{1.20}{or of Thy truth}
\pl{2.40}{in destruction?\hspace{0.90em}[v. 11]}
\pl{0.00}{Shall Thy wondrous works be known in the dark, and Thy}
\pl{1.20}{righteousness in the land where all things are forgotten?\hspace{0.90em}[v. 12]}
\pl{0.00}{For the grave cannot praise Thee, neither shall death celebrate}
\pl{1.20}{Thee.\hspace{0.60em}They that go down into the pit cannot hope for Thy}
\pl{1.20}{truth.\hspace{0.90em}[Isa. 38:18]}
\pl{0.00}{The living, the living, he shall praise Thee.\hspace{0.90em}[v. 19]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[2.] \emph{In vain.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Hast Thou made all men for nought?\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 89:46]}
\pl{0.00}{Enter not into judgment with Thy servant, for in Thy sight}
\pl{1.20}{shall no man living}
\pl{2.40}{be justified.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 143:2]}
\pl{0.00}{If Thou, Lord, wilt be extreme to mark iniquities, O Lord, who may}
\pl{1.20}{abide it?\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 130:3]}
\pl{0.00}{If He will contend with him, he cannot}
\pl{1.20}{answer Him one of a thousand.\hspace{0.90em}[Job 9:3]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[3.] \emph{The Triumph of the Enemy.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Give not Thine heritage to reproach,}
\pl{1.20}{that the heathen should rule over it.\hspace{0.60em}Wherefore should they say among the peoples,}
\pl{1.20}{Where is now their God?\hspace{0.90em}[Joel 2:17]}
}

\pglabel{printed 298}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{Memor esto hujus: Inimicus improperavit}
\pl{2.40}{Domino, et populus insipiens incitavit}
\pl{3.60}{nomen Tuum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} lxxiv. 18.}
\pl{0.00}{Superbia eorum qui Te oderunt ascendit semper.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Ver.} 23.}
\pl{0.00}{Dicent Ægyptii; Callide eduxit eos,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Exod.} xxxii. 12.}
\pl{1.20}{ut interficeret in montibus et deleret e terra.}
\pl{0.00}{Dicent Chananæi; Non poterat introducere populum in}
\pl{1.20}{terram pro qua juraverat,}
\pl{2.40}{idcirco occidit eos in solitudine.\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Num.} xiv. 16.]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[VI.] EX PARTE CONSEQUENTIS BONI.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[1.] \emph{Gloria nominis.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Propter gloriam nominis Tui, Domine,}
\pl{1.20}{Libera nos.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} lxxix. 9.}
\pl{0.00}{Nos populus Tuus confitebimur Tibi in sæculum:}
\pl{0.00}{In generationem et generationem}
\pl{1.20}{annunciabimus laudem Tuam.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Vers.} 13.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[2.] \emph{Conversio aliorum.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Docebo iniquos vias Tuas, et impii}
\pl{1.20}{ad Te convertentur.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} li. 13.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[3.] \emph{Exemplum.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Sed ideo misericordiam consecutus sum, ut in me primo}
\pl{1.20}{ostenderet Christus Jesus omnem patientiam ad in-}
\pl{1.20}{formationem eorum qui credituri sunt Illi in vitam}
\pl{1.20}{æternam.\hspace{0.90em}1 \emph{Tim.} i. 16.}

\pglabel{printed 298}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{Remember this: the enemy hath reproached}
\pl{2.40}{the Lord, and the foolish people hath blasphemed}
\pl{3.60}{Thy Name.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 74:18]}
\pl{0.00}{The pride of them that hate Thee increaseth ever more and more.\hspace{0.90em}[v. 23]}
\pl{0.00}{The Egyptians shall say: For mischief did He bring them out,\hspace{0.90em}[Exod. 32:12]}
\pl{1.20}{to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the earth.}
\pl{0.00}{The Canaanites shall say: He was not able to bring the people into}
\pl{1.20}{the land which He sware unto them,}
\pl{2.40}{therefore He slew them in the wilderness.\hspace{0.90em}[Num. 14:16]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[VI.] ON THE PART OF THE GOOD THAT WOULD FOLLOW.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[1.] \emph{The Glory of Thy Name.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{For the glory of Thy Name, O Lord,}
\pl{1.20}{Deliver us.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 79:9]}
\pl{0.00}{So we that are Thy people will give Thee thanks for ever:}
\pl{0.00}{From generation to generation}
\pl{1.20}{we will shew forth Thy praise.\hspace{0.90em}[v. 13]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[2.] \emph{The Conversion of Others.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Then shall I teach the wicked Thy ways, and the ungodly}
\pl{1.20}{shall be converted unto Thee.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 51:13]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[3.] \emph{The Example.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{But for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first}
\pl{1.20}{Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a}
\pl{1.20}{pattern to them which should hereafter believe on Him unto life}
\pl{1.20}{everlasting.\hspace{0.90em}[1 Tim. 1:16]}
}

\pglabel{printed 299}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{[4.] \emph{Ipse Deus.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Deleo iniquitates propter Me.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Is.} xliii. 25.}
\pl{0.00}{Exaudi, attende, ne moreris}
\pl{2.40}{propter Temetipsum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Dan.} ix. 19.}
\pl{0.00}{Ipse quem proposuit Deus propitiationem.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Rom.} iii. 25.}
\pl{0.00}{Respice in faciem Christi Tui.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} lxxxiv. 9.}
\pl{0.00}{Non avertas faciem Christi Tui.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} cxxxii. 10.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[5.] \emph{Ex genere.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Miserere mei, Fili David.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Matt.} xv. 22.}
\pl{0.00}{Et dixit David Shemei, Non morieris,}
\pl{2.40}{juravitque ei.\hspace{0.90em}[2 \emph{Sam.} xix. 23.]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[6.] \emph{Ex officio.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Spiritus Dei super Me, eo quod unxerit.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Is.} lxi. 1.}
\pl{0.00}{Dominus ad annunciandum mansuetis}
\pl{1.20}{misit Me, ut mederer contritis corde.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Luc.} iv. 18.}
\pl{0.00}{Veni vocare peccatores.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Matt.} ix. 13.}
\pl{0.00}{Misit Deus Filium, ut salvetur mundus}
\pl{1.20}{per Ipsum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Jo.} iii. 17.}

\pglabel{printed 299}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{[4.] \emph{God Himself.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{I, even I, am He that blotteth out iniquities for Mine own sake.\hspace{0.90em}[Isa. 43:25]}
\pl{0.00}{Hear, attend, defer not,}
\pl{2.40}{for Thine own sake.\hspace{0.90em}[Dan. 9:19]}
\pl{0.00}{Even He whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation.\hspace{0.90em}[Rom. 3:25]}
\pl{0.00}{Look upon the face of Thine Anointed.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 84:9]}
\pl{0.00}{Turn not away the face of Thine Anointed.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 132:10]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[5.] \emph{From kindred.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Have mercy on me, O Thou Son of David.\hspace{0.90em}[Matt. 15:22]}
\pl{0.00}{And David said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die,}
\pl{2.40}{and sware unto him.\hspace{0.90em}[2 Sam. 19:23]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{[6.] \emph{From office.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{The Spirit of the Lord is upon Me, because He hath anointed Me.\hspace{0.90em}[Isa. 61:1]}
\pl{0.00}{The Lord hath sent Me to preach good tidings unto the meek,}
\pl{1.20}{to heal the broken-hearted.\hspace{0.90em}[Luke 4:18]}
\pl{0.00}{I came to call sinners.\hspace{0.90em}[Matt. 9:13]}
\pl{0.00}{God sent His Son, that the world through Him}
\pl{1.20}{might be saved.\hspace{0.90em}[John 3:17]}
}

\sectionhead{§8 *Confessio Laudis*}

\pglabel{printed 299}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{CONFESSIO LAUDIS.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{PROPTER}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Excellentiam Majestatis.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Clarifica Me, Pater, apud Teipsum,}
\pl{1.20}{claritate quam habui, priusquam mundus esset.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Jo.} xvii. 5.}
\pl{0.00}{Melchisedech erat Sacerdos Dei altissimi.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Gen.} xiv. 18.}

\pglabel{printed 299}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{THE CONFESSION OF PRAISE.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{FOR}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{The Excellency of [His] Majesty.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Glorify Me, O Father, with Thine own self,}
\pl{1.20}{with the glory which I had with Thee before the world was.\hspace{0.90em}[John 17:5]}
\pl{0.00}{Melchizedek was the priest of the most high God.\hspace{0.90em}[Gen. 14:18]}
}

\pglabel{printed 300}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{\emph{Celsitudinem.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Quia excelso excelsior est alius.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Eccles.} v. 8.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Æternitatem.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Invoca nomen Dei æterni.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Gen.} xxi. 33.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Omnipræsentiam.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Nunquid non cœlum et terram impleo?}
\pl{1.20}{dicit Dominus.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Jer.} xxiii. 24.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Omniscientiam.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Quo ibo a Spiritu Tuo, et quo a facie Tua fugiam.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Ps.} cxxxix. 7.}
\pl{2.40}{Si ascendero in cœlum, Tu illic;}
\pl{2.40}{Si descendero ad infernum, ades; etc.\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Vers.} 8.]}
\pl{0.00}{Tu omnia nosti,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Jo.} xxi. 17.}
\pl{0.00}{Quia Tu nosti solus cor omnium filiorum hominum,\hspace{0.90em}1 \emph{Reg.} viii. 39.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Omnipotentiam.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Non est impossibile apud Deum omne verbum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Luc.} i. 37.}
\pl{0.00}{Ego Deus omnipotens.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Gen.} xvii. 1.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Altitudinem Sapientiæ.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O altitudo divitiarum scientiæ et sapientiæ Dei! quam}
\pl{1.20}{incomprehensibilia sunt judicia Ejus, et investigabiles}
\pl{2.40}{viæ Ejus?\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Rom.} xi. 33.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Inconcussam veritatem.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Veritas Domini manet in æternum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} cxvii. 2.}

\pglabel{printed 300}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{\emph{[His] Highness.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Because higher than the highest there is Another.\hspace{0.90em}[Eccles. 5:8]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{[His] Eternity.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{He called on the name of the everlasting God.\hspace{0.90em}[Gen. 21:33]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{[His] Omnipresence.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Do not I fill heaven and earth?}
\pl{1.20}{saith the Lord.\hspace{0.90em}[Jer. 23:24]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{[His] Omniscience.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Whither shall I go from Thy Spirit, or whither shall I flee from Thy presence?\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 139:7]}
\pl{2.40}{If I climb up into heaven, Thou art there;}
\pl{2.40}{If I go down to hell, Thou art present also; etc.\hspace{0.90em}[v. 8]}
\pl{0.00}{Thou knowest all things,\hspace{0.90em}[John 21:17]}
\pl{0.00}{For Thou, even Thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men,\hspace{0.90em}[1 Kings 8:39]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{[His] Omnipotence.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{With God nothing shall be impossible.\hspace{0.90em}[Luke 1:37]}
\pl{0.00}{I am the Almighty God.\hspace{0.90em}[Gen. 17:1]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{The Depth of [His] Wisdom.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O the depth of the riches both of the knowledge and wisdom of God! how}
\pl{1.20}{unsearchable are His judgments, and His ways}
\pl{2.40}{past finding out!\hspace{0.90em}[Rom. 11:33]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{[His] Unshaken Truth.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{The truth of the Lord endureth for ever.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 117:2]}
}

\pglabel{printed 301}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{Cœlum et terra transibunt,}
\pl{0.00}{Verba autem Mea non præteribunt.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Matt.} xxiv. 35.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Exquisitam justitiam.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Justitia Ejus manet in sæculum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} cxi. 3.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Fontem, Oceanum, Abyssum misericordiæ.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Abyssus abyssum invocat.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} xlii. 7.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Mitis, præterire, dissimulare.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Obsecro vos per mansuetudinem}
\pl{1.20}{et modestiam Christi.\hspace{0.90em}2 \emph{Cor.} x. 1.}
\pl{0.00}{Non delebo propter decem.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Gen.} xviii. 32.}
\pl{0.00}{Transis peccatum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Mich.} vii. 18.}
\pl{0.00}{Tempora ignorantiæ dissimulans Deus.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Act.} xvii. 30.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Tolerans, Longanimis.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{An divitias patientiæ et longanimitatis contemnis?\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Rom.} ii. 4.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Misericors.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ipse misericors et propitius peccatis eorum, ut non dis-}
\pl{1.20}{perderet eos.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} lxxviii. 38.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Illibenter puniens.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Quid faciam tibi, Ephraim?}
\pl{2.40}{quid faciam tibi, Juda?\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Hos.} vi. 4.}
\pl{0.00}{Liberasti eos multis temporibus, et pertransisti super eos}
\pl{2.40}{annos multos:\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Neh.} ix. 28. [30.]}
\pl{0.00}{Et in misericordiis Tuis plurimis,}
\pl{2.40}{non fecisti eos in consumptionem.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Vers.} 31.}

\pglabel{printed 301}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{Heaven and earth shall pass away,}
\pl{0.00}{but My words shall not pass away.\hspace{0.90em}[Matt. 24:35]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{[His] Perfect Righteousness.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{His righteousness endureth for ever.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 111:3]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{The Fountain, the Ocean, the Deep of mercy.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{One deep calleth another.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 42:7]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Meek — to pass by, to overlook.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{I beseech you by the meekness}
\pl{1.20}{and gentleness of Christ.\hspace{0.90em}[2 Cor. 10:1]}
\pl{0.00}{I will not destroy it for ten's sake.\hspace{0.90em}[Gen. 18:32]}
\pl{0.00}{Thou passest by transgression.\hspace{0.90em}[Mic. 7:18]}
\pl{0.00}{God, winking at the times of ignorance.\hspace{0.90em}[Acts 17:30]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Forbearing, Longsuffering.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Or despisest thou the riches of His forbearance and longsuffering?\hspace{0.90em}[Rom. 2:4]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Merciful.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{But He, being merciful, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed}
\pl{1.20}{them not.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 78:38]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Unwilling to punish.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{What shall I do unto thee, O Ephraim?}
\pl{2.40}{what shall I do unto thee, O Judah?\hspace{0.90em}[Hos. 6:4]}
\pl{0.00}{Thou didst deliver them many times, and passedst over them}
\pl{2.40}{many years:\hspace{0.90em}[Neh. 9:28,30]}
\pl{0.00}{And in Thy manifold mercies,}
\pl{2.40}{Thou didst not utterly consume them.\hspace{0.90em}[v. 31]}
}

\pglabel{printed 302}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{Non secundum peccata nostra facit nobis,}
\pl{1.20}{neque secundum iniquitates nostras retribuit nobis.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} ciii. 10.}
\pl{0.00}{Suscepit de manu Domini duplicia pro}
\pl{1.20}{omnibus peccatis suis.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Is.} xl. 2.}
\pl{0.00}{Quomodo misertus pater filiorum, misertus est Dominus}
\pl{1.20}{timentibus Eum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} ciii. 13.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Compatiens.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Pœnitens mali.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Joel.} ii. 13.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Cito desinens.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Non in perpetuum irascetur,}
\pl{1.20}{neque in æternum comminabitur.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} ciii. 9.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Pronus ad veniam.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Dimissi tibi omne debitum, quia rogasti Me.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Mat.} xviii. 32.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Reconciliationem.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Reconcilians mundum Tibi, non reputans}
\pl{1.20}{delicta mundi.\hspace{0.90em}2 \emph{Cor.} v. 19.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Propitiationem.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Cito proferte stolam primam, et induite eum; et date}
\pl{1.20}{annulum in manum ejus; et adducite vitulum sagi-}
\pl{1.20}{natum, etc.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Luc.} xv. 22, [23.]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Χρηστός.}}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Quia Ipse benignus est super ingratos}
\pl{1.20}{et malos.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Luc.} vi. 35.}

\pglabel{printed 302}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{He hath not dealt with us after our sins,}
\pl{1.20}{nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 103:10]}
\pl{0.00}{She hath received of the Lord's hand double for}
\pl{1.20}{all her sins.\hspace{0.90em}[Isa. 40:2]}
\pl{0.00}{Like as a father pitieth his children, so is the Lord merciful}
\pl{1.20}{unto them that fear Him.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 103:13]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{\emph{Compassionate.}}
\parasep

\pl{0.00}{THE AGGRAVATION.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{1. The measure of the sin, \{ as harm, / as scandal. \}}

\pl{1.20}{1. Folly,}
\pl{1.20}{2. Ingratitude,}
\pl{1.20}{3. Hardness,}
\pl{1.20}{4. Contempt.}

\sectionhead{§22 *Confessio Peccati*}

\pglabel{printed 334}{Latin}

\pl{1.20}{CONFESSIO PECCATI.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{DEUS, Tu scis insipientiam meam, et delicta mea a Te}
\pl{1.20}{non sunt abscondita.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} lxix. 5.}
\pl{0.00}{Cognosco et ego, et peccatum meum contra me est}
\pl{1.20}{semper.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} li. 3.}
\pl{0.00}{Non abscondo peccatum, sicut Adam.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Job.} xxxi. 33.}
\pl{0.00}{Non declino cor meum in verba malitiæ, ad excusandas}
\pl{1.20}{excusationes in peccatis.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} cxli. 4.}
\pl{0.00}{Sed confiteor adversum me injustitiam meam.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Ps.} xxxii. 5.}
\pl{1.20}{Et omnia quæ intra me sunt,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} ciii. 1.}
\pl{1.20}{Et omnia ossa mea dicunt,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} xxxv. 10.}
\pl{2.40}{Peccavi,\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.} cvi. 6.}
\pl{1.20}{Peccavi Tibi, Domine.}
\pl{1.20}{Erravi sicut ovis quæ periit.\hspace{0.90em}[\emph{Psal.} cxix. 176.]}
\pl{0.00}{Protervus fui, sicut juvenca indomita.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Jer.} xxxi. 18.}
\pl{0.00}{Reversus sum sicut canis ad vomitum:\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Prov.} xxvi. 11.}
\pl{1.20}{Sicut sus lota, in volutabro luti.\hspace{0.90em}2 \emph{Pet.} ii. 22.}
\pl{0.00}{Do Tibi gloriam, Domine, et confiteor,}
\pl{1.20}{Peccavi Tibi, et sic et sic feci.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Jos.} vii. [19, 20.]}
\pl{0.00}{Ὦ Κύριε, λίνον τυφόμενον μὴ σβέσῃς,}
\pl{1.20}{κάλαμον συντετριμμένον μὴ κατεάξῃς.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Matt.} xii. 20.}
\pl{0.00}{Ne me demergat tempestas aquæ,}
\pl{1.20}{Neque absorbeat me profundum,}
\pl{2.40}{Neque occludat super me puteus os suum.\hspace{0.90em}\emph{Psal.}}
\pl{3.60}{lxix. [15.]}
\pl{0.00}{Domine, ante Te omne desiderium meum,}

\pglabel{printed 334}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{1.20}{THE CONFESSION OF SIN.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O GOD, thou knowest my foolishness, and my sins are not}
\pl{1.20}{hid from thee.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 69:5]}
\pl{0.00}{I also acknowledge it, and my sin is ever}
\pl{1.20}{before me.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 51:3]}
\pl{0.00}{I hide not my sin, as Adam did.\hspace{0.90em}[Job 31:33]}
\pl{0.00}{I incline not my heart to words of malice, to make}
\pl{1.20}{excuses in sins.\hspace{0.90em}[Ps. 141:4]}

\sectionhead{§24 *Confessio Laudis*}

\pglabel{printed 345}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{CONFESSIO LAUDIS.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Peccantem me, Domine, et non pœnitentem,}
\pl{2.40}{ac ita prorsus indignum,}
\pl{0.00}{Magis deceret coram Te jacere prostratum,}
